    # Solid-color separator rows and columns divide the grid into tiles.
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1]
    def spans(n, seps):
        bounds = [-1] + seps + [n]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds)-1) if bounds[i]+1 < bounds[i+1]]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in spans(len(grid), row_seps):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in spans(len(grid[0]), col_seps):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row.append(1 if count == 2 else 5)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
